article.title: Saving of laws in respect of anti-national activities
article.content: Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 2 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).
article.html:
31DSaving of laws in respect of anti-national activities

Article 31D · Part III · Saving of Certain Laws

Omitted by the Constitution (Forty-third Amendment) Act, 1977, s. 2 (w.e.f. 13-4-1978).

1 Ins. by the Constitution (Forty-second Amendment) Act, 1976, s. 5 (w.e.f. 03-01-1977).
